selected_evidence.requirement: Create and trust OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Certificate subject and issuer are CN=OS Comparison Root CA; CA:TRUE and Certificate Sign constraints are present; system-bundle verification returns OK.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 914a587f-a589-4816-8b05-3557a58aa02a; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 1058072f-7283-489a-9737-1a925a046389; the key, certificate, packages, CA attributes, fingerprint, and system trust verification all recovered successfully.

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 700 /etc/ssl/private
install -d -m 755 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
stat -c 'key_mode=%a key_owner=%U:%G key_path=%n' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
stat -c 'cert_mode=%a cert_owner=%U:%G cert_path=%n' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -check -noout
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | grep -A4 'X509v3 Basic Constraints'
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
